import numpy as np
L=np.log(P)
Pb={'1/P':1/P,'1':P**0,'P':P,'P2':P**2,'P3':P**3,'PL':P*L,'P2L':P**2*L,'L':L}
Tb={'1':t**0,'t':t,'t2':t**2,'e':np.exp(-t),'s':np.sin(t),'c':np.cos(t)}
names=[];cols=[]
for a,pa in Pb.items():
    for b,tb in Tb.items():
        names.append(a+'|'+b); cols.append(pa*tb)
D=np.column_stack(cols)
c=np.linalg.lstsq(D,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
r=dP_dt-D@c
print("full NMSE %.3e"%(np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt)), D.shape)
# greedy backward: drop smallest-impact columns
keep=list(range(D.shape[1]))
while len(keep)>6:
    best=None
    for j in keep:
        k2=[x for x in keep if x!=j]
        c2=np.linalg.lstsq(D[:,k2],dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        e=np.mean((dP_dt-D[:,k2]@c2)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
        if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,j)
    keep.remove(best[1])
print([names[k] for k in keep], "%.3e"%best[0])
c2=np.linalg.lstsq(D[:,keep],dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
print(np.round(c2,4))
